title: Feel flimsy but work
text: Feel flimsy but work. These knifes are very light weight but almost too light weight as the blade feels flimsy. The handles feel kind of cheapy. They do work but just don’t feel like the best quality.

description: Paring knives are essential tools in every kitchen. This Farberware professional Paring knife set offers two serrated stainless steel blades with a rounded edge. This type of blade is useful for cutting through tough meats and vegetables. Stainless steel blades are lightweight and durable, while soft handles provide a comfortable non slip grip.
